# THORACIC SURGERY (INCLUDES SECTION ON ESOPHAGEAL PROCEDURES)

# Esophageal Surgical Procedures:

# Prophylaxis:

[Cefazolin weight based dosing once pre-op + Metronidazole 500mg once IV pre-op](orz-set-abx-cefazo-wt-based-iv-metron-500mg-iv-preop)

beginning 60 minutes before incision

Prophylaxis recommendations includes BOTH MEDICATIONS q8h for 2 doses post-op.

Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis orders after admission.

# Alternative for patients with beta-lactam allergy:

[Clindamycin 900 mg IV over 30 minutes, beginning 60 minutes before incision](psjizid-clindamy-900mg-iv-once-preop)

($) [H,O]

Prophylaxis recommendation includes q8h for 2 doses post-op.

Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order after admission.

# ___________________________________________________________________________

# Thoracic surgery (except for esophageal procedures):

Includes video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) and non-cardiac procedures,

including lobectomy, pneumonectomy, lung resection and thoracotomy.

# No post-operative doses are recommended.

# Prophylaxis

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

# Alternative for patients with beta-lactam allergy:

[Clindamycin 900 mg IV over 30 minutes, beginning 60 minutes before incision](psjizid-clindamy-900mg-iv-once-preop)

($) [H,O]

# Alternative for patient colonized or recently infected with MRSA

[Vancomycin 15 MG/KG IV beginning 120 minutes before incision \($\) R](orzid2-gmenu-surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)

# References

Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis

in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 Vol 70 page 195-283

Antimicrobial Prophylaxis for Surgery, Treatment Guidelines from The Medical

Letter 2012 Vol 10 pages 73-77
